correctness.rationale: The continuous Poissonized independent coordinate refresh semigroup gives A(t)=∏q_i(1-e^-t/m) from empty, B(t)=∏(q_i+p_i e^-t/m) from full; strong Markov renewal implies Laplace transform m!/Q(v), v=ms, with Q(v)=∑e_k∏_{l≠k}(v+l), e_k elementary symmetric of r_i=p_i/(1-p_i). At -j, Q(-j)=(-1)^j j!(m-j)! e_j. For exactly d>0 losses this establishes strict alternating signs and unique roots in (-(j),-(j-1)) for j<=d, and untouched -j roots for j>d, hence a genuine independent geometric factorization. Strict convex log[1+up/(1-p)] proves Schur PGF order; direct positive pair-balancing cost proves strict mean order; fixed-budget extremizers and P>=1 unbounded supremum follow. Independently for m=3 p=(1/10,1/5,3/10), Q=(250v³+1350v²+2055v+756)/126 has roots approximately -0.54073,-1.87225,-2.98702 and exact Markov-state PGF E[2^-T]=84/2869 agrees with m!/Q(3).

This proof provides a polynomial-root reduction for the heterogeneous model; full primary articles inaccessible, retained as priority risks.

value.rationale: An exact full first-completion law and fixed total erasure-budget extremizers are natural quantitative invariants of the nonmonotone coupon system. The sharp threshold P=1 between attained finite worst profiles and infinite supremum, strict allocation ordering and exact geometric-factor interlacing are useful structural facts beyond a restatement of the classical coupon collector.

limitations: Only uniform coupon selection, independent coordinate refresh with p_i<1, first all-present hitting time.
PGF order is not asserted to imply ordinary stochastic domination; high loss budget P>=1 has infinite supremum, not attained.
